* Ensure the chimney stack is clean and free of debris to improve airflow and prevent clogging.  
* Use high-quality mortar that matches the existing material for a durable and aesthetically pleasing result.  
* Check the structural integrity of the chimney stack before beginning the repointing process.  
* Apply the new mortar in a consistent layer to ensure even coverage and proper bonding.  
* Allow sufficient time for the mortar to set and cure before using the chimney stack again.  
* Maintain proper ventilation during the repointing to ensure safety and even distribution of the mortar.  
* Consult a professional if unsure about the proper technique or materials to use.
